_comment: Edit the copy THERE, not here, and run:

prompter.text:
The Nerdster. Somebody else's service --
nothing to do with my identity app.

It needs to know who I am.
I have no account here, and I am not making one.
My app makes the Nerdster a key of its own.

That key is a delegate: it speaks for me here,
and nowhere else.
Signed in. My identity key never left the phone.
No password. No email. Nothing to be breached.
